messages.content: amar ekta bhul hoyeche kaj e, boss ke bolbo naki nijer theke fix kore nebo
How serious is the mistake, is it something that could get worse if hidden?
hae, actually beshi din chepe rakhle problem barbe
Tahole sathe sathe bolা better, delay করলে trust issue create hote pare later. Directly, defensive na hoye - "ekta bhul hoyeche, eta fix korার plan ache" emon bhabe bolo.
That's natural, but most managers actually respect proactive honesty more than a perfect record. Fix korার plan sathe niye gele conversation ta onek e shohoj hoye jabe.
